clips.title: The story
paras: Furen Longbeard sends his crafting notes across the sea to Mathiel in Darnassus. The night elf smith works on the Warrior's Terrace, where dwarven mail forging may reach a new pair of hands.

Furen Longbeard has mastered the forging of fire-hardened armor and chooses to share what he has learned with other Alliance craftsmen. He copies his technical diagrams and sends you across the continents to Mathiel, a smith on Teldrassil.

On Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, Mathiel tends a forge for the Sentinels and other fighters who defend the night elf capital. Furen's notes carry dwarven methods from the underground forges of Khaz Modan to kaldorei armorers, whose craft is shaped by their bond with nature.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need them sent to the blacksmith Mathiel. He lives in Darnassus which is quite a long way off, but I'm sure he'll be very grateful to learn what I've learned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are interesting, very interesting indeed. My dwarven colleague Furen has made quite a grand discovery!
Thank you, friend. It will be an honor to apply his new techniques to my own craftings.
